_doc: Regulatory fees per market. Distinct from broker commission and from transaction taxes (see tax_rules.json). Many of these are bundled into IBKR's `commissionReport.commission` field for retail accounts; the calculator can choose to either treat the broker commission as all-inclusive or to add these on top depending on the account profile. SEC and FINRA TAF rates change annually — refresh from official schedules.

sells_only.sec_fee_doc: SEC Section 31 fee. Rate set annually by SEC; $27.80 per $1M of notional sold (i.e. 0.278 bps). Buyers exempt.
sells_only.finra_taf_doc: FINRA Trading Activity Fee. $0.000166/share on covered sells, capped at $8.30 per trade.

US_ETF.notes: Same SEC + FINRA TAF as common stock.

both_sides.nfa_doc: NFA assessment fee per side. Tiny (rounding-error level).
both_sides.exchange_fee_doc: CME exchange fee already in broker_ibkr.json under exchange_fee_per_contract; do NOT double-count.

FUT_CFE.notes: CFE NFA + exchange fee model is identical in shape.

FX_IDEALPRO.notes: Spot FX has no SEC/FINRA fees. Some venues levy a small assessment but it's bundled into IBKR commission for retail.

both_sides.clearing_doc: Eurex Clearing per-execution fee. Often bundled into IBKR commission.

buys_only.ptm_doc: Panel on Takeovers & Mergers levy: £1.00 on UK equity trades >= £10,000 notional, on the buy side.
